help.title: Billing and payment options
paragraphs: Pay Bill Now needs no login and has no fee; it accepts cards including Amex, plus Venmo, Apple Pay and Google Pay. To pay by phone with a card or checking account, call 800-221-0051 and say Make a Payment.
You can also mail your payment, pay at one of four customer service locations or the drop box, or pay cash at participating Western Union Quick Collect locations.

help.title: Automatic Payments
paragraphs: Automatic Payments are free. Each monthly bill shows the amount due and the date it will be deducted from your designated bank account.

help.title: Registering for My Account
paragraphs: Have a recent bill ready. Enter your account number and account name exactly as they appear on the bill, create a username (no spaces) and password, and answer three security questions used for password resets.

Passwords must be 8 to 32 characters with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter and one number or special character. Use Forgot Username or Forgot Password on the login screen if you need help, or call 800-221-0051.

help.title: Payment arrangements and assistance
paragraphs: If you have a past-due balance, you may be able to pay it in monthly installments: sign in to My Account, open the Billing and Payment tab and select Payment Arrangements, or call 800-221-0051.
The Equal Payment Plan spreads your estimated yearly gas costs over 12 monthly payments. Grants and other help are available to eligible customers with limited income or a temporary hardship.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Use the Stop, Start Existing Service request in My Account: validate your account, look it up, confirm your personal information, choose a stop date and time, then review and confirm. You can also call 800-221-0051.
